name: BJ
source:
[Chapter 1]
I haven't seen BJ in person, either. But in-game he's always there to cover us, even at the cost of his life. Joyful guy. He also seems to be a bit closed off.

[Chapter 2]
[spoiler] BJ is a funny guy, but he's been through something that is really hard for me to imagine. He's clearly trying to hide his pain deep inside. I think that he's truly happy only in a simulation. [/spoiler]
translation:
[Chapter 1]
I haven't seen BJ in person, either. But in-game he's always there to cover us, even at the cost of his life. Joyful guy. He also seems to be a bit closed off.

[Chapter 2]
[spoiler] BJ is a funny guy, but he's been through something that is really hard for me to imagine. He's clearly trying to hide his pain deep inside. I think that he's truly happy only in a simulation. [/spoiler]
